entities.summary: Wayne Pigram, known professionally as Wayne Pygram, is an Australian actor and musician. He is known for his role as Scorpius in the science fiction series Farscape (2000-2004). He briefly appeared in Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith, portraying Grand Moff Tarkin in 2005. He also appeared in the television series Lost in 2006.
